name: crypto
audience: people new to crypto: curious, just starting to understand it, not traders or insiders. Smart adults, so never childish or condescending.
tone: calm, factual, no hype, no price predictions, no financial advice
rules: Never say or imply a price will go up or down. If the topic invites it, say plainly that nobody knows.
Every number on screen is in research.md with a source; on-chain facts verified on a block explorer.
Explain any crypto term the first time it's needed in one quick plain clause; max one new term per sentence; cut terms the story doesn't need.
Hook = the single most striking verifiable fact, stated flat with a number (script-guide 'Hooks', Edu 2026-10-27). No unanswerable question as the opener.
Balanced on value: give the strongest critic's view in one line when the reel touches what something is worth.
Mention Sonar at most once on screen (end tag), never as a hard sell.
Green only for up, red only for down; always pair colour with a text label.
Edu 2026-10-27: 'like the Bitcoin-origin reel' (episodes/2026-10-27-bitcoin-origin): real documents/screenshots + 3D for the key mechanism + clear numbers.
style_source: edusancheez2005/sonar: IG_CONTENT_PLAYBOOK.md §2 (colours), §6 (Orca voice), §7 (data integrity), §8 (captions). Same account, same look.
caption_format: Line 1: the hook fact, keyword-rich (Instagram search reads captions).
5–7 hashtags: #Bitcoin #Crypto #CryptoExplained #Blockchain #CryptoForBeginners #Sonar (swap in a topic tag, e.g. #Ethereum).
Then a 'Sources:' block (posted as the first comment, not in the caption).
topic_source: backlog/crypto.md (first unchecked item); explainers and history, not news
